name: Chlormezanone
aliases: chlormethazanone, Chlormethazanone, Chlormezanona, Chlormezanonum, Clormezanona, Fenaprim®, Trancopa®
summary: Chlormezanone (marketed under the brandname Trancopal or Fenaprim) is a drug used as an anxiolytic and a muscle relaxant.

uses.text: Chlormezanone (marketed under the brandname Trancopal or Fenaprim) is a drug used as an anxiolytic and a muscle relaxant. Its use was discontinued in many countries in 1996 due to rare but serious cases of toxic epidermal necrolysis.

pharmacology.en: Its mechanism is not well understood. It depresses the central nervous system, which relaxes muscles and eases anxiety.
pharmacology.zh: 它的作用機制尚不清楚。它會抑制中樞神經系統，進而放鬆肌肉並緩解焦慮。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的作用机制尚不清楚。它会抑制中枢神经系统，进而放松肌肉并缓解焦虑。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness and weakness. Rarely it caused toxic epidermal necrolysis, a life-threatening reaction in which the skin blisters and peels, which led to its withdrawal in many countries.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、頭暈與無力。罕見情況下它會引發毒性表皮溶解症，這是一種皮膚起水泡並剝落、可能危及生命的反應，因此它在許多國家被撤出市場。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、头晕与无力。罕见情况下它会引发毒性表皮溶解症，这是一种皮肤起水泡并剥落、可能危及生命的反应，因此它在许多国家被撤出市场。

fact.en: Chlormezanone has a ring containing a sulfur atom that has been oxidised to a sulfone, carrying two oxygen atoms. This is an unusual feature among sedative drugs.
fact.zh: Chlormezanone 有一個含硫原子的環，其中的硫被氧化成帶兩個氧原子的碸基，這在鎮靜藥物中相當少見。
fact.zhHans: Chlormezanone 有一个含硫原子的环，其中的硫被氧化成带两个氧原子的砜基，这在镇静药物中相当少见。
